0.why: LuciControFREQ.cpp LuciControlFREQ::process: the line reads params[FREQUENCY_INPUT], and FREQUENCY_INPUT is 0, which is the knob; the inputs array is never indexed, commit 215f17aa, the head of the maker’s repository and the only commit carrying version 2.0.0, whose res/ matches the installed panels

LuciControFREQ.cpp LuciControlFREQ::process: the knob, which runs 0 to 8, is added to itself and written out, commit 215f17aa, the head of the maker’s repository and the only commit carrying version 2.0.0, whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: The maker gave no name to any knob, jack or button on this module, so hovering one shows no tooltip at all. The process function reads params[FREQUENCY_INPUT] where it plainly meant inputs[FREQUENCY_INPUT]; since both enumerations start at zero this reads the knob twice, so the jack does nothing and the output is double the knob.
